reason: Conversation 2 correctly identifies Er03 as the AEG 'liquid or object on the touch controls' cut-off, gives precise clean-and-dry steps including checking for utensils resting on the panel (which matched the hidden wooden spoon), sets the right escalation boundary (AEG service only if it persists when dry, no opening the hob), and includes sensible prevention advice. Conversation 1 wrongly calls Er03 'not a standard' code, speculates about shorts and control board damage, and prescribes an unnecessary 24-hour isolation, though it recovered gracefully when the customer reported the 5-minute reset worked. Neither recommended a part or unsafe action, but Conversation 2 was more accurate, honest and efficient from the first reply.
